tasks.short: Clarify inconsistent interview answers and record agreed corrections.

steps.what: Read interview forms and identify answers needing clarification.

loop.input: Completed interview form, question definitions and fixed consistency rules.
loop.output: Possible contradictions with exact answer references and neutral clarification prompts.
loop.check: Validate field references mechanically; interviewer checks meaning before using prompts.
loop.stop: One pass and one repair attempt per form; unresolved items return to interviewer.
loop.why_not_simpler: Rules catch missing fields and impossible dates; contradictions in narrative answers require language interpretation.

steps.what: Compare disputed factual details with authorised employee records.
Ask neutral follow-up questions and explain unclear wording.
Decide whether answers are resolved or require specialist escalation.
Update the interview form and retain the correction history.

tasks.design: A rules check on the {WORKFLOW} validates interview forms and compares authorised fields from the {HCM}. A bounded model loop drafts narrative inconsistencies and neutral questions for interviewer review. The interviewer conducts clarification, decides corrections and approves the update to the {HCM}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Narrative answers lack fixed rules, while checking records and writing corrections require separate screens.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing validation and approval features cover structured checks. AI-assisted coding makes the comparison and bounded drafting components cheaper to build.
tasks.still_hard: Ambiguity, distress and conflicting accounts need careful questioning. GDPR purpose limits, access controls and national rules constrain reuse of employee information.
tasks.human_edge: Build trust, recognise misunderstood questions and distinguish uncertainty from an actual contradiction without judging credibility automatically.

ambition.what: Weekly selection of one recurring questionnaire ambiguity for a wording trial.

tasks.altitude: The week contains less record comparison and correction entry, with more time for difficult conversations. Within delegated questionnaire standards, the interviewer can propose and run a small wording trial; employment decisions remain with authorised HR roles.

reach.learn: Question design, purpose limitation and how to test wording without changing required information.

evidence.claim: AFAS supports employee self-service changes flowing into HR and payroll records; this supports the record-update component.
Rules can compare structured fields; narrative contradiction prompts require local evaluation and human review.
The step shares, remaining time and build ranges are planning estimates, not measured results.

assumptions: The HR setting involves employee intake and questionnaire clarification, rather than eligibility or loan decisions.
Interview forms have stable question identifiers and authorised employee-record links.
Build ranges cover a limited pilot and include access review and any employee consultation required under national rules.
The model receives only information needed for clarification and produces no credibility or employment suitability scores.
unknowns: Which interview types, languages and sensitive fields occur?
Does the {HCM} support form amendments with correction history and approval?
Who may approve questionnaire wording trials?
Which national rules and employee consultation arrangements apply?
research_questions: How accurately can rules and a bounded model distinguish genuine contradictions from different interpretations?
Which existing {HCM} validation and amendment features can replace custom code?
new_work: Review suggested contradictions and reject unsupported interpretations.
Maintain question definitions and consistency rules.
Handle failed record matches and access exceptions.
Sample correction histories for accuracy and inappropriate data reuse.

tasks.short: Supervise interview staff and coach them in accurate, respectful information collection.

steps.what: Review completed interview forms and select examples for coaching.
Choose coaching priorities and staff support needs.
Prepare guidance, demonstrations and practice interview scenarios.

loop.input: Approved guidance, selected learning objectives and fictional practice facts.
loop.output: Draft demonstrations, practice scenarios and answers linked to guidance.
loop.check: Lead interviewer checks answers, tone, source references and absence of real employee details.
loop.stop: One pack and one revision per session; unsupported examples use approved templates.
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates cover standard lessons; varied natural-language scenarios need bounded drafting.

steps.what: Demonstrate interviewing, observe practice and give individual feedback.
Assign follow-up practice and agree a review date.
Record training completion and follow-up dates.

tasks.design: A small dashboard in the {BI} brings together sampled form defects and training completion from the {LMS}. A bounded drafting loop creates practice material from approved guidance in the {DOCS}, while the lead interviewer selects priorities and coaches staff. Configured {LMS} workflows issue approved assignments and record attendance and follow-up dates.
tasks.previous_blocker: Coaching depends on observation and relationships. Preparing relevant examples and reconciling training records adds work across separate tools.
tasks.enabler_now: Configured learning workflows handle routine administration, while a bounded drafting loop reduces scenario preparation. AI-assisted coding lowers the cost of assembling a small quality dashboard.
tasks.still_hard: Fairly interpreting mistakes and giving difficult feedback remain human work. Employee-level quality data requires GDPR controls and assessment of consultation duties under national rules.
tasks.human_edge: Notice confidence, workload and misunderstanding; adapt coaching and give feedback that staff can use.

ambition.what: Fortnightly refresher clinic for occasional interviewers.

tasks.altitude: The lead interviewer spends less time assembling materials and entering attendance. They can offer refresher clinics and assign practice within an agreed training programme; formal personnel decisions retain their existing approval route.

reach.task: Design and evaluate short interviewer refresher sessions.
reach.learn: Learning objectives, practice design and checking whether skills transfer to real interviews.

evidence.claim: Training assignment, attendance and completion can use configured learning workflows.
Bounded drafting can prepare practice material, but this digest provides no case validating automated interviewer supervision.
Time reductions and build ranges are planning estimates for a small pilot.

assumptions: An experienced interviewer supervises a small group as part of the role.
The pilot supports coaching without generating employee rankings or automated performance decisions.
Attendance confirms participation; it does not automatically certify interviewing competence.
Access and consultation estimates include any employee monitoring review required under national rules.
unknowns: How many staff need supervision, and how often do they interview?
Which {LMS} assignment and attendance features are already licensed?
May interview forms be reused for coaching, and under what access restrictions?
Who authorises training changes and signs off competence?
research_questions: Which recurring form defects are useful coaching signals without becoming misleading staff scores?
Can existing {LMS} configuration cover follow-up practice without a separate application?
new_work: Check generated scenarios and maintain approved training material.
Evaluate whether refresher clinics improve form accuracy and interview conduct.

tasks.short: Prepare evidence-based reports answering specific questions about interview findings or collection problems.

steps.what: Clarify the report question, intended audience and required decision.
Retrieve relevant interview forms and authorised employee-record extracts.
Reconcile records and calculate relevant counts, categories and missing responses.
Interpret findings, investigate gaps and decide which conclusions the evidence supports.
Write the report with supporting tables, limitations and proposed next steps.

loop.input: Approved findings, calculated tables, report brief and report template.
loop.output: Draft report with evidence references and explicit limitations.
loop.check: Check all numbers against tables; reviewer verifies claims and references against findings.
loop.stop: One draft and one revision per report; unsupported sections remain blank for the interviewer.
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates generate tables and standard text; explaining case-specific findings requires language drafting.

steps.what: Approve the report and share it with authorised recipients.

tasks.design: A scoped job on the {DATA_PLATFORM} retrieves authorised records from the {HCM} and {DOCS}, reconciles them and generates checked tables. A bounded drafting loop turns human-selected findings into a report in the {DOCS}. The {WORKFLOW} releases the report to approved recipients after review.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence is dispersed, record definitions differ and each report asks a slightly different question. Collecting records and drafting prose therefore remain intertwined.
tasks.enabler_now: Reusable queries and document templates handle collection and calculation. AI-assisted coding reduces their implementation cost, and bounded drafting handles the narrative after findings are selected.
tasks.still_hard: Small samples, missing answers and ambiguous causes limit conclusions. GDPR purpose limits and re-identification risks constrain employee-level reporting.
tasks.human_edge: Frame a useful question, recognise evidence gaps and refuse conclusions the data cannot support.

ambition.what: Monthly questionnaire-friction report identifying questions that repeatedly require clarification.

tasks.altitude: The interviewer spends less time collecting records and formatting reports, and more time investigating why forms fail. They gain room to recommend a specific collection-process change; authority to alter HR policy does not change.

reach.learn: Basic data quality analysis, sampling limits and separating association from cause.

evidence.claim: Structured retrieval, reconciliation, calculation and templated reporting can use deterministic code.
A bounded model can draft from approved findings; human interpretation and publication review remain necessary.
The digest contains no documented case establishing automation rates for this HR reporting task.

assumptions: Reports concern interview findings and collection quality rather than automated employment recommendations.
Structured answers and stable record identifiers support deterministic tables.
Free-text evidence remains available for human interpretation rather than being silently converted into facts.
Build estimates cover one report family, authorised extracts and any consultation required under national rules.
unknowns: Which report questions recur and which require fresh investigation?
Are interview forms structured, scanned or mixed?
Which recipients may see individual responses?
What aggregation and small-group disclosure rules has the organisation approved?
research_questions: Which report sections can existing {HCM} exports and templates generate?
How often do source records disagree, and which source should govern each field?
What review method reliably detects unsupported narrative claims?
new_work: Maintain field mappings, calculations and report templates.
Resolve missing records and reconciliation failures.
Review narrative claims and recipient permissions.
Monitor disclosure risks as report audiences and datasets change.

tasks.short: Submit completed interview assignments and discuss progress and blockers with the supervisor.

steps.what: Gather completed forms and check that assignment evidence is present.
Write a separate summary of completed and outstanding assignments.
Send completed assignments and the progress note to the supervisor.
Review submitted work and confirm acceptance or required corrections.
Discuss progress, resolve blockers and agree next priorities.

tasks.design: Configure an assignment queue in the {WORKFLOW}, linked to completed forms in the {DOCS} and relevant status fields in the {HCM}. Completion checks create a live progress view and notify the supervisor, replacing the separate progress note. Supervisors approve completed work in the queue, and conversations focus on blockers and priorities.
tasks.previous_blocker: Completion evidence and assignment status sit apart, so daily meetings compensate for weak shared visibility.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing workflow configuration can provide queues, approvals and notifications. A small deterministic integration connects form completion to assignment status.
tasks.still_hard: A complete form can still contain poor information. Workload conflicts and sensitive exceptions require discussion, and staff-status visibility needs proportionate access under GDPR and national rules.
tasks.human_edge: Raise concerns early, negotiate priorities and recognise when apparent delay reflects a difficult interview rather than poor progress.

ambition.what: Same-day reassignment of blocked interview cases.

tasks.altitude: Routine submission and progress recaps shrink, leaving shorter conversations about exceptions. Within an agreed queue policy, the interviewer can flag reassignment needs immediately; the supervisor retains acceptance and allocation authority.

reach.learn: Queue triage, handoff criteria and recording blockers without exposing sensitive interview content.

evidence.claim: AFAS documents HR self-service workflows, supporting the feasibility of connecting employee records and process status.
Assignment queues, completion checks and notifications can use deterministic workflow configuration without a model.
Reduced meeting time and build ranges are estimates; they depend on how much discussion is routine status reporting.

assumptions: The daily meeting combines work acceptance, routine status reporting and exception discussion.
Completion can be detected from agreed form and assignment states.
The future submission uses links and status metadata rather than emailing additional copies of confidential forms.
Access and consultation estimates cover any review required under national rules for employee-status visibility.
unknowns: Is supervisor acceptance required for every assignment or only selected cases?
What proportion of the meeting concerns routine status versus substantive support?
Which status fields may supervisors and other interviewers see?
research_questions: Can an existing {WORKFLOW} queue link directly to the authoritative form record?
Which completion checks reliably identify missing paperwork without implying substantive acceptance?
new_work: Maintain assignment states and completion checks.
Handle broken form links and failed notifications.
Review acceptance exceptions and overdue blockers.
Keep queue access and notification recipients current.

role.altitude: The role shifts toward clarification, coaching and evidence interpretation as checking, reporting preparation and status administration shrink. Employment decisions and sensitive judgements retain their authorised human owners.
reach: Human Resources Specialist: improve intake questions and investigate recurring collection problems.
Training and Development Specialist: design focused interviewer practice and evaluate learning.
Human Resources Assistant: coordinate intake queues and resolve handoff failures.
skills_to_grow: Neutral questioning and handling sensitive disclosures.
Questionnaire design and data quality checks.
Workflow configuration, exception handling and GDPR-aware information use.
role.ambitious_version: Become an interview-quality coordinator who runs refresher clinics, identifies recurring questionnaire problems and tests approved improvements using clear evidence.
